name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world
title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island (Pre-Release) - Cobbly Jungle
description:
The cobbly jungle FG from Yoshi's Island's early builds, I don't remember which build this was from, but I decided to pick it up because I think it looked cool, I added a lot of things here because the original tileset was basically unfinished, unlike the leafy grassland one that looked sort of finished.

NOTICE: this tileset will use palette slots 3, 4 and 5 for the trees'/bushes' colors, plus the berry tile is already in the game's FG2 files
